items.title: SD-016 MECH-152 soft-selection ablation: discriminate selection-hardness interaction vs mechanism absence (A2_SOFTSEL vs A1_PRODUCTION, 1-knob)
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from governance confidence/conflict scoring). Follow-on of V3-EXQ-922; does NOT supersede it (922's production-combination evidence stands: MECH-150 CONFIRMED, MECH-151 SUPPORTS scoped, MECH-152 FAIL 0/3, ARC-041 dissociation signature met but HELD). Confirmed autopsy: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-922_2026-08-13.(md|json); substrate_queue.json SD-016 mech152_note_2026_08_13 recommends exactly this ablation (driver-only new arm, no substrate build). QUESTION: is V3-EXQ-922's MECH-152 collapse under the production hard-Gumbel combo (A1_PRODUCTION r_w_harm_mean=0.0013, r_w_goal_mean=-0.0077, both 0/3) SELECTION-HARDNESS-SPECIFIC or a GENUINE MECHANISM ABSENCE? 922's A0_OFF (legacy soft selection) scored much closer to the 194a thresholds (0.356/-0.355) -- a real but 3-knob-confounded lead. This driver discriminates the selection axis by a clean 1-KNOB ablation. DESIGN: 3 arms x 3 seeds [42,43,44]; MECH-152 terrain machinery (end-to-end retrieval collection, 194a-corrected w_goal_target<0.33, promoted compute_context_divergence_loss, phased P0a=60/P1=40, readiness preconditions) IDENTICAL to 922. A0_OFF (tagger=False, soft, ctxdiv=0.0) = MECH-150 C2 saddle control + reproduces 922's closest-to-threshold arm; A1_PRODUCTION (tagger=True, gumbel, ctxdiv=0.5) = reproduces 922's collapse in-run; A2_SOFTSEL (tagger=True, soft, ctxdiv=0.5) = THE ABLATION, differs from A1 in selection ONLY (gumbel->soft), tagger+ctxdiv held. Primary contrast A2 vs A1. LOAD-BEARING PREMISE (interpretation.preconditions, recomputable via majority-order statistics): A2_SOFTSEL retrieval selective (sel_entropy<2.5 AND sel_context_divergence>0.1) AND A2 terrain series non-degenerate (hazard varies AND terrain_weight varies) -- else self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue / a2_terrain_series_degenerate, NEVER a mechanism verdict. VERDICT LABELS: selection_hardness_confirmed_full (A2 clears BOTH 194a thresholds, A1 does not -> mechanism present but hard-Gumbel-suppressed); selection_hardness_partial_recovery (A2 recovers toward both thresholds vs A1 by >RECOVERY_MARGIN=0.15, grounded in 922's ~0.35 A0-vs-A1 gap, without full pass); mechanism_absence_indicated (A2 also flat -> NOT selection-specific); both_selections_recover_a1_not_reproduced / inverted_hard_better_than_soft (confound/unexpected -> re-examine). DV-SYMMETRY (per arm): the selection swap changes retrieved cue_context as a point in space (not an affine rescale of A1's terrain series), so Pearson r_w is free to differ -- manipulation NOT invariant under the DV's symmetry group; genuine measurement. MECH-151 action_bias_div recorded per arm as INFORMATIVE context (feeds ARC-041's HELD dual-pathway disposition) but NOT a scored claim here. claim_ids=[MECH-152] (single, accurate: this directly tests MECH-152 terrain content-tracking; ARC-041 is informed downstream, not directly re-measured). RESOLVES MECH-152 pending_retest_after_substrate; INFORMS ARC-041 HELD -- does NOT finalize either (that is /governance's call once this lands). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (r_w_harm/r_w_goal under tagger+soft+ctxdiv via the real retrieval path with 194a-corrected threshold) recorded in NO prior manifest -- 907's A2_ctxdiv_l0p5 (config-close) measured only MECH-150 selection metrics via inline pre-promotion ctxdiv, never the MECH-152 terrain collection; 922 ran soft only on the tagger-OFF A0 arm -> genuine new run. GATES cleared this session: 2.5b re-derive brake (MECH-152 count=0, first autopsy in lineage), 2.5c substrate-path overlap (only open entry mech203 severity unset, non-overlapping E1 cue path), 2.5a empirical probe (tagger=True/soft/ctxdiv=0.5 instantiates, extract_cue_context + compute_context_divergence_loss confirmed), 2.6 ethics all-false/allow. NAMING road-not-taken: considered a new EXQ NUMBER (question genuinely differs from 922's production-combo test), but the autopsy+chip explicitly direct 'a new letter' and it is a driver-clone lineage sibling; used 922a and deliberately set NO 'supersedes' (922's evidence is not invalidated). Smoke: --dry-run rc=0, all 9 cells (3x3) ran, arms produce arm-varying non-trivial readouts (A2_SOFTSEL seed43 r_w_harm=-0.29/r_w_goal=0.47 vs A1 sel_entropy=0.0), 9 verdict lines, dry-run manifest correctly relocated out of evidence/, self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue under p0a=2 exactly like 922 (real run p0a=60). validate_experiments.py --strict clean, 0 warnings all categories. items.title: Uncensored survival-to-death fishtank, TRUE single-life design -- MULTI-SEED re-run of V3-EXQ-920 (explicit --seeds 0..7; supersedes 920's 1-of-8-seeds execution defect)
items.note: Re-run of V3-EXQ-920 with the SEED-COUNT WORKAROUND applied. V3-EXQ-920 FAILed for an execution/wiring reason only: its queue entry correctly declared "seeds": 8 but carried no "args", and experiment_runner.py's run_experiment() builds subprocess CLI args ONLY from the item's "args" field (raw_args = item.get('args', []))  -- the declarative "seeds" count feeds only the progress-bar denominator (_run_axis_count), never a --seeds CLI arg  -- so the driver's own argparse default (--seeds default=[0]) silently ran a SINGLE seed. n_uncensored_deaths_total=1 < MIN_UNCENSORED_DEATHS_TOTAL=4 -> load-bearing sufficient_uncensored_deaths FAIL. The one seed that ran behaved exactly as pre-registered (genuine health_depleted death at 1475 steps, pct_right_censored_pooled=0.0 -- literally zero censoring; the self-route label '...still_censoring_dominated' is a hardcoded else-branch string, NOT a measurement finding). Governance-ratified routing: failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-916-916a-917-920-fishtank-cluster_2026-08-12.md Target 4 (status confirmed, interactive AskUserQuestion gate 2026-08-12) recommends exactly this re-queue as V3-EXQ-920a with explicit "args":["--seeds",...]. THE ONLY CHANGE from 920 is the added "args" field; the driver script is byte-identical and unchanged. Workaround CONFIRMED by dry-run smoke (--dry-run --seeds 0 1 -> two 'Seed N Condition' boundaries and two 'verdict: PASS' lines, rc=0, z_goal_stream active_frac=0.998 no writer defect); the runner passes args verbatim so --seeds 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 executes all 8. This is the exact infra defect the autopsy identified; the general fix (enforce queue-declared seed count into --seeds, or fix the driver default) is governance's / a separate infra chip's to apply and is NOT re-proposed here. GOV-REUSE-1 (2.4): the decisive readout (a TRUE single-continuous-life uncensored survival-time distribution at n>=4) is recorded in NO existing manifest -- 920 produced n=1, every prior 906-lineage segment was capped at 500 steps -- not recoverable, run required. Re-derive brake (2.5b): claim_ids=[], N/A. Downstream: the multi-seed within-life descriptive trend analysis (chip-20260812-exq920-multiseed-degradation-retrospective) runs once this lands, and feeds the DV set + sleep cadence for the matched-arm causal follow-up (chip-20260814-queue-causal-sleep-matched-arm). Diagnostic; excluded from governance confidence/conflict scoring. Ethics preflight (2.6): all-false / allow -- pre-ethical V3 instrumentation, SENT-0 boundary, same design as 920/912 already adjudicated.
